name: Lying Pullover (Cable)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley, holding a bar or rope behind your head.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the bar in an arc over your face to above your chest.
Squeeze your lats at the top.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A lying cable pullover that keeps constant tension on the lats and chest.
